<think><details><summary>Thought Process</summary>
Starting implementation of T06.

The plan covers six concrete steps. A `TicketStatusTransitions` domain policy will validate legal state changes. An `InvalidTransitionException` will represent forbidden transitions. A `TransitionTicketRequest` DTO will carry the target status. The service layer will receive a transition method. The controller will expose a POST endpoint. Invalid transitions will return HTTP 422 via `ResponseStatusException`.

A minimal `@ControllerAdvice` will map `InvalidTransitionException` to HTTP 422. This keeps the domain exception clean for T10 while still satisfying the UI requirement for meaningful errors.

A bare `ResponseStatusException` may not yield the required JSON contract. A thin `ApiExceptionHandler` could map `InvalidTransitionException` to HTTP 422 with the correct body shape. That risks doing part of T10 prematurely.

The plan explicitly permits returning 422 for invalid transitions now. I will throw InvalidTransitionException from the domain policy. The service will catch and rethrow it. A minimal exception handler will map it to HTTP 422. This keeps the domain exception clean for T10.

The plan now favors a simpler layered approach. `TicketStatusTransitions` will live purely in the domain layer and throw `InvalidTransitionException`. The service will catch this domain exception and map it to HTTP 422 via `@ResponseStatus(HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY)`. This avoids premature exception handling and keeps the domain exception clean for T10.

A minimal exception handler will map InvalidTransitionException to HTTP 422 with the API contract error body. This satisfies the hard rule for meaningful UI errors without doing part of T10. The handler stays focused on this single exception.

Reconsidered the exception strategy. Implementing the full 422 error body for invalid transitions now aligns with T10, which only extends the mapping later. Will create a `TicketStatusTransitions` domain policy, `InvalidTransitionException`, `TransitionTicketRequest`, a service transition method, a controller POST endpoint, and a minimal `ApiExceptionHandler`. A dedicated `ErrorResponse` DTO and `ErrorDetail` type will match the API contract exactly.

Updating the `TicketStatus` Javadoc to reference T06. Marking T06 complete in `plan.md`. Checking `api-standards` for the exact error body format.
</details></think>

```bash
set -e
BASE=http://localhost:8080/api/tickets

# Create
CREATE=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$BASE" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"T06 transition check","description":"verify state machine","priority":"MEDIUM"}')
HTTP=$(echo "$CREATE" | tail -1)
BODY=$(echo "$CREATE" | sed '$d')
echo "CREATE HTTP=$HTTP"
ID=$(echo "$BODY" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['id'])")
STATUS=$(echo "$BODY" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['status'])")
echo "id=$ID status=$STATUS"
test "$STATUS" = "OPEN"

transition() {
  local target=$1
  local expect_http=$2
  RESP=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$BASE/$ID/transition" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -d "{\"status\":\"$target\"}")
  CODE=$(echo "$RESP" | tail -1)
  RBODY=$(echo "$RESP" | sed '$d')
  echo "→ $target HTTP=$CODE"
  echo "$RBODY" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('  status=', d.get('status'), 'code=', d.get('code','n/a'), 'msg=', d.get('message','n/a')[:80])"
  test "$CODE" = "$expect_http"
}

# Happy path
transition IN_PROGRESS 200
transition RESOLVED 200
transition CLOSED 200

# Deny CLOSED → OPEN
transition OPEN 422
AFTER=$(curl -s "$BASE/$ID")
echo "After deny GET status=$(echo "$AFTER" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['status'])")"
test "$(echo "$AFTER" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['status'])")" = "CLOSED"

# Cancel path on a fresh ticket
CREATE2=$(curl -s -X POST "$BASE" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"T06 cancel","description":"cancel path","priority":"LOW"}')
ID2=$(echo "$CREATE2" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['id'])")
curl -s -o /tmp/t06c.json -w "%{http_code}" -X POST "$BASE/$ID2/transition" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"status":"CANCELLED"}' > /tmp/t06c.code
echo "OPEN→CANCELLED HTTP=$(cat /tmp/t06c.code) status=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('/tmp/t06c.json'))['status'])")"
test "$(cat /tmp/t06c.code)" = "200"

# IN_PROGRESS → CANCELLED
CREATE3=$(curl -s -X POST "$BASE" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"T06 cancel2","description":"ip cancel","priority":"LOW"}')
ID3=$(echo "$CREATE3" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['id'])")
curl -s -X POST "$BASE/$ID3/transition" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"IN_PROGRESS"}' > /dev/null
curl -s -o /tmp/t06c2.json -w "%{http_code}" -X POST "$BASE/$ID3/transition" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"status":"CANCELLED"}' > /tmp/t06c2.code
echo "IN_PROGRESS→CANCELLED HTTP=$(cat /tmp/t06c2.code) status=$(python3 -c "import json; print(json.load(open('/tmp/t06c2.json'))['status'])")"
test "$(cat /tmp/t06c2.code)" = "200"

# Extra denies: RESOLVED→OPEN (need a ticket at RESOLVED - create new)
CREATE4=$(curl -s -X POST "$BASE" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"T06 reopen deny","description":"x","priority":"LOW"}')
ID4=$(echo "$CREATE4" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['id'])")
curl -s -X POST "$BASE/$ID4/transition" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"IN_PROGRESS"}' > /dev/null
curl -s -X POST "$BASE/$ID4/transition" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"RESOLVED"}' > /dev/null
RESP=$(curl -s -w "\n%{http_code}" -X POST "$BASE/$ID4/transition" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"status":"OPEN"}')
echo "RESOLVED→OPEN HTTP=$(echo "$RESP" | tail -1)"
test "$(echo "$RESP" | tail -1)" = "422"
ST=$(curl -s "$BASE/$ID4" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['status'])")
echo "status unchanged=$ST"; test "$ST" = "RESOLVED"

echo "ALL T06 checks passed"
```
